review_candidates.title: Office Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Office Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for ensuring the smooth daily operation of the studio’s office environment. The Office Administrator maintains office supplies and equipment, supports filing and documentation, and assists with the preparation of reports, presentations, and internal communications. The role includes coordinating travel and logistics for team members, supporting onboarding of new hires with basic administrative task
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Office Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for ensuring the smooth daily operation of the studio’s office environment.
Ability to work on-site in Cairo, collaborate with diverse teams, and maintain confidentiality and professionalism.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Strong Office Administration and Administrative Assistance skills, with experience managing schedules, documentation, and day-to-day office operations. Hands-on experience with Office Equipment, including printers, scanners, telephones, and basic troubleshooting of common office hardware. Proficiency in productivity software (e.g., Microsoft Office or Google Workspace) and basic data entry and record-keeping.
